title: alchemilla vulgaris subvar. obtusa
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subvar. obtusa, commonly known as the Lady's Mantle, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating menstrual irregularities, heavy bleeding, and menopausal symptoms due to its emmenagogic and astringent properties. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla vulgaris subvar. obtusa include stimulating menstrual flow, reducing inflammation, and soothing digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
